function.name: set_volume
function.description: Adjust the volume level of the car's radio system.

volume_level.description: The desired volume level, between 0 (muted) and 100 (maximum).

function.name: adjust_volume
function.description: Adjust the volume level of the car's radio system.

volumen_increment.description: The increment by which to increase or decrease the volume. Positive values increase the volume, and negative values decrease it.

function.name: toggle_radio
function.description: Turn the car radio on or off.

state.description: The state of the radio. Can be 'on' to turn the radio on or 'off' to turn it off.

function.name: toggle_mute_radio
function.description: Mute or unmute the car's radio based on the given state.

state.description: The state of the radio. Can be 'mute' to mute the radio or 'unmute' to unmute it.

function.name: change_radio_station
function.description: Change the car's radio to one of the available stations.

station.description: The radio station to tune to. Available options are 'radio1', 'radio2', 'radio3', and 'radio4'.
